structure: Double helix of 240 spheres (120 blue strand + 120 pink strand, additive blending) + 150 drifting text particles + core glow. Three.js r160 via CDN (external dependency — note for offline).
agent_use: The helix is a touchable code metaphor: data as physical structure. 'You can touch the code' is the design law for the Archive's walkable monoliths.
